From: Liam O'Rourke <liam@luma.ai>

Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Trial credits expired — short-term access request

Hi Soojin,

We ran into procurement delays last week and our trial instance hit zero credits this morning. The team still needs a few days to get the PO and internal signatures in place, but we have an immediate validation window this week where we need to finish a 3rd-party integration test. Is there any chance Redwood can provision temporary sandbox access or a small credit top-up for ~7 days so we can complete the test?

Quick context: we're evaluating streaming generation and embeddings for a multimodal assistant. If we can finish the integration this week we plan to move forward with a 6-month Dedicated POC.

Thanks for any help — I can jump on a short call if needed.

— Liam
Liam O'Rourke
Head of ML Infrastructure, Luma AI
liam@luma.ai

Hi Liam — thanks for the note and the context. Sorry to hear procurement slowed things down. We can often make a one-off bridge provision for active pilots while procurement completes.

Before I request a specific top-up, two quick asks so we make the right configuration:
- Confirm the immediate workload: are you primarily doing short-form generation (chat-like) or heavy embedding/indexing?
- Do you need streaming enabled during the test or is batch generation fine?

I'm looping in Jordan and Karthik to help approve a temporary credit grant and confirm billing/MPA steps.

I attached a short policy summary so you know the typical guardrails (bridge_credit_policy.pdf). If helpful, we can provision a 7-day sandbox credit and extend by a further 7 days once procurement shows progress.

Best,
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Enterprise SDR, Redwood Inference

Soojin —

Liam flagged a legitimate procurement delay and the account looks like a strong POC candidate (multimodal assistant, likely Dedicated). I support a one-off bridge credit. Propose we provision a 75k token sandbox credit valid for 7 days and include a playbook email with access instructions and our MPA link so their legal can move quickly.

Marissa, can you own the onboarding steps once we provision? Karthik, confirm we can apply this as a promotional credit and attach deal id RD-2027-LLUMA-034. If there's any concern about scope (embedding-heavy) call it out.

Jordan
